name: Transaction Allocation 2
definition: Set of elements used to identify each underlying allocation.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money in the allocation.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the allocation is a debit or credit.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account to which the allocation is due or from.

Purpose.name: Purpose
Purpose.definition: Underlying reason for the allocation.||Usage: This applies to the allocation only, this is not the underlying reason for the payment.

RelatedReferences.name: Related References
RelatedReferences.definition: Reference relating to the allocation which is meaningful to both parties (for example the original Securities Settlement Transaction Identification).

UnderlyingAllocationGuideline.definition: UnderlyingAllocation may only be present if bilaterally agreed.
